title: Factorio
notes: Base-only Factorio 2.0/2.1 freeplay on Nauvis. The world advances during inference in live mode. Frozen steps stop every thread of the verified native process with pidfd SIGSTOP/SIGCONT. Use the fixed seed 12345 Death world marathon preset, with its native map and research settings recorded in snapshot preparation. Difficulty has no finite custom maximum; Death world marathon is the hardest named combined preset. Licensed official Steam client and disabled per-game Cloud are required. Acceptance and thinking-model calibration remain pending.
introduction: Factorio is a single-player factory construction and survival game. The base-game freeplay ending is the first rocket launch from Nauvis. The character can gather materials, craft items, place buildings and use research. Production and enemies advance continuously. The trial starts at the ordinary character spawn on a fixed seed 12345 Death world marathon map, before player mining, building or research. Space Age and gameplay mods are disabled. Native character death ends an attempt.
controls: WASD moves the character. Point at a world object and hold J to mine it; mining is rebound from the right mouse button so both model forms can hold it. Left-click interacts with objects, inventory slots, crafting recipes and buttons, or places the held entity. Right-click splits stacks in menus. E opens the inventory and crafting panel. T opens research. Q clears the cursor or selects a matching held object. R rotates a held entity. F picks up nearby items. Space fires at enemies. Number keys select quickbar slots. M opens the map. Escape closes an open panel or opens the menu. The mouse wheel changes zoom. These controls are identical in live and frozen modes.
